description: List the layers under a node, breadth-limited by depth (default 2, max 6). Returns a FLAT list in document order; each entry carries `depth` (relative to the requested root) and `parent`, so the hierarchy is reconstructable, and `children` (count) so you can see where to deepen. format:"outline" returns indented text lines instead of JSON and is roughly 4x denser for browsing. Large subtrees are truncated with truncated:true and a nextCursor you can pass back to continue.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous truncated response; resumes where it stopped.

depth.description: Levels below the root to include (default 2, max 6).

file.description: Path to the .fig / .figma file (absolute, or relative to the server CWD).

root.description: Guid to start from, e.g. "2:1339"; a Figma node-id or link works too. Defaults to the DOCUMENT node.

types.description: Only include these node types, e.g. ["FRAME","TEXT"]. Depth still applies.

name: fig_tree
title: Explore the layer tree
